verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is a client-side rendering library, but a machine-readable API spec (or an equivalent such as published type definitions or a JSON API dump) is a fair ask for a framework, so the axis applies. The pack shows no such downloadable artifact: OpenAPI and Swagger paths all return 404. 'TypeScript support with full IntelliSense' and the HTML typedoc pages are adjacent and are never described as a downloadable machine-readable spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
